title: Pope Leo XIV visits Lourdes after Paris mass to meet clergy sexual abuse victims
description: After two days in Paris where he drew hundreds of thousands of worshippers, Pope Leo XIV will continue his visit to France on Sunday in the southwestern pilgrimage town of Lourdes with a private meeting with victims of clergy sexual abuse. Leo's four-day trip is the first official papal visit to France in nearly two decades.
